title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Account Maintenance: Autopay and Payment Due Day
content:
## Autopay

On a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account, autopay is set up or cancelled only on the borrower's own authorization. Enrollment draws a payment only when it is in place at least the stated days before that payment's due date; an earlier due date is paid by another channel.

## Payment due day

The payment due day may be moved to any day from the earliest to the latest allowed day of the month. A due day change can be made only when no other due day change was made in the preceding 365 days. A due day change takes effect from the next statement period and never skips or delays a payment already due.

The preceding 365 days are the rolling 365 calendar days ending on the day the change is handled, and the changes counted are the due day changes recorded on that financing account.

## Due day change at a glance

| Another due day change recorded on the account in the preceding 365 days | Change can be made |
|---|---|
| None | Yes, to a day from the earliest to the latest allowed day; effective from the next statement period |
| One or more | No |

## Hypothetical cases

- A borrower whose last due day change was recorded 400 days ago has none in the preceding 365 days, and the due day can be moved; the new day applies from the next statement period, and a payment already due keeps its date.
- A borrower whose last change was recorded 200 days ago cannot change the due day.
- With a lead time of 5 days, autopay enrolled 3 days before a due date does not draw that payment; that due date is paid by another channel.

The day counts are illustrative.
